definitions.explanation: A soft, flavored substance that is chewed but not swallowed.

examples.japanese: チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧。
⟦{眠気|ねむけ}→眠気：06534_nemuke⟧{覚|ざ}まし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought some chewing gum to stay awake.

examples.japanese: チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}み→噛む：01205_kamu⟧⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Chewing gum while talking to someone is often considered rude.

notes:
A loanword from English "chewing gum." In everyday conversation, the shortened form ⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧ is far more common. チューインガム is the formal, full-length term seen on product packaging and in official contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{噛|か}む→噛む：01205_kamu⟧: to chew gum
- チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捨|す}てる→捨てる：00892_suteru⟧: to throw away gum
- チューインガム⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吐|は}き{出|だ}す→吐き出す：06856_hakidasu⟧: to spit out gum
- ⟦{板|いた}ガム→板ガム：18366_itagamu⟧: stick gum (flat rectangular pieces)
- ⟦{粒|つぶ}→粒：03892_tsubu⟧⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧: pellet gum (coated pieces)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ガム→ガム：00058_gamu⟧: gum — the everyday abbreviated form, used much more frequently in speech
- ⟦{風船|ふうせん}ガム→風船ガム：25082_fuusengamu⟧: bubble gum — gum specifically designed for blowing bubbles
